name: registry-bypasses

result.issue: wp_mail() called directly in 4 places (challenge created / entry submitted / voting open / finalized) instead of routing through a notification abstraction or Free's mvs_send_email helper
result.rationale: These are templated lifecycle emails — not generic transactional sends. Free does NOT yet expose a unified email-send abstraction. Until Free ships one, the direct wp_mail() calls are the documented pattern (in-app notifications via mvs_notification_types are added at lines 52-57). Acceptable in 1.2.0; revisit when Free adds an EmailService. Tracked under Pro's known-debt for ChallengeService.

notes: Sub-check 2.5.12. Scanned for: (a) wp_mail() outside an email service, (b) raw `MATCH AGAINST` SQL outside a search abstraction, (c) direct $wpdb->get_results() calls bypassing repository pattern, (d) curl_exec/file_get_contents bypassing wp_remote_*. (a) found 4 hits in ChallengeNotificationListener — see result. (b) zero MATCH AGAINST queries in Pro (Free owns search). (c) MediaRepository (Free) is the documented exception per CLAUDE.md Section 3 + Phase 1 boundary interfaces; Pro's repositories aren't yet extracted (TournamentService and ChallengeService are flagged in CLAUDE.md Section 8 'Known Debt'). (d) zero — all HTTP via wp_remote_post/get.
